document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your wounds swell and discolor. Your entire body flames with 
fever.  You  lapse  into  longer  and  longer  periods  of  delirium. 
When the end comes, you are completely unaware of it.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
